#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

unordered_map<int, long long> tab1_cache;
unordered_map<pair<int, int>, long long, hash_pair> tab2_cache;

struct hash_pair {
    size_t operator()(const pair<int, int>& p) const {
        return hash<int>()(p.first) ^ (hash<int>()(p.second) << 1);
    }
};

long long calc_num1(int x) {
    if (x < 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (x < 2) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (tab1_cache.find(x) == tab1_cache.end()) {
        long long sum_result = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < x; ++j) {
            sum_result += calc_num1(j) * calc_num1(x - 1 - j);
        }
        tab1_cache[x] = sum_result;
    }
    return tab1_cache[x];
}

long long calc_num2(int x, int y) {
    if (x < 0 || y <= 0 || x >= (1 << (y - 1))) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (x < 2) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (x < y) {
        return calc_num1(x);
    }
    pair<int, int> key = make_pair(x, y);
    if (tab2_cache.find(key) == tab2_cache.end()) {
        long long sum_result = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < x; ++j) {
            sum_result += calc_num2(j, y - 1) * calc_num2(x - 1 - j, y - 1);
        }
        tab2_cache[key] = sum_result;
    }
    return tab2_cache[key];
}

int main() {
    int a, b;
    cin >> a >> b;
    cout << calc_num1(a) - calc_num2(a, b) << endl;
    return 0;
}
